storyInfo: Red helps Closure and Tonya under the walls of Zelgrad. They escape with the help of another Infected group, and the three parties form a temporary alliance. In Deity Grypherburg, Eloysius learns from the spy that her father chose to collude with the pro-war faction in order to protect her, and makes her own choice.

attributes.content: Look out!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure's drones manage to fend off the first wave of attacks, even with their capabilities restricted to flight.
But their limitations quickly show as she attempts to shield the stranger from the same attacks.
The plasma shield doesn't work either! Damn this thing!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Look oooooouuuuutttt!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Over here. Take your drone.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Stay behind me.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Is that a blast shield? But the material—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Why did you stay behind? You already got on the tractor!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You helped the Doctor, didn't you? Besides, some people have a knack for acting before thinking... just think of me as being their rear guard.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The door's shut, but at least they got in—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Push forward! Surround them and take them in!
attributes.name: Stern Soldier

attributes.content: Ugh—!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I got you. Looks like we'll have to run in the opposite direction.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Hey, you—are you Infected?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: It's complicated, but vampires don't normally get Oripathy—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...I have no idea. You're the first Sarkaz I've seen...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Right now, though, it's a good thing.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Good? Why?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Hopefully, it means we'll only end up in a police station—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: More reinforcements? Okay, NOW I'm done!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Wait, I don't think it's—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: What did you say?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Do your drones still work? Can you use it to draw them to the other side?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I want to check—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: —Bravo, turn around and attack the intruders!
attributes.name: Stern Soldier

attributes.content: Good, they're not on the same side. I don't know who they are, but we gotta run towards them!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Beats getting caught by the First Army.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: They're distracted. Run!
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: You're—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: You think there's time for self-introductions?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Come with me if you want to live.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: They're still hot on our tails. We're outside the jamming area now, I can draw their attention with a drone.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Try.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Well, try is the only thing I can do—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: No. 6 ready, max speed, high visibility mode—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: *huff*... *pant*...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: That should distract some of them...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Hey, are you okay? I'm taking off your mask—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: What's your name? Are you hurt?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Me? I'm Tonya...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Nice name. The drones are off. Let me see if you're hurt. I know a thing or two about first-aid.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm just... cold...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You're losing blood. Did a bolt hit you?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I don't know...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I think... I've seen the mark on his back before...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Reunion...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Forget about that for now! There's a wound on your leg.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Take this.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: What is it?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Medicine. Apply it and grab on—
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I'm taking another route.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: What's different about this one?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Narrower and more remote.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: But not narrow enough that their vehicles can't get in.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Correct, but it'll buy us some time.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: How many did the drone draw away?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: A quarter, at most. They're probably just going after No.6 to make sure there are no loose ends.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: We're dead if we can't shake at least half of them before they set up roadblocks ahead.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I-I'll think of something!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: You'd better. We need to stop and find the entrance to the underground layer.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: It's safer underground.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Wait, stop—we can't go around!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: There's someone ahead!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: A miner?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: But not one of us. You're—
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: We met in the apartments.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: This is no place to chat. Come with me if you trust me.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We found a place underground—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Let's go. We have people on our tail.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: You all know each other?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Take her from the vehicle. I'll drive it off to somewhere hidden.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: There's no need! We'll go together. I'll have a drone hide it for you.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It'll last until morning, at least. Let's go.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: <p=1>Zelgrad Underground Layer</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 01:46</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: The scouts have returned!
attributes.name: Returning Miner

attributes.content: No movement from the Army after we shook them. Rumor has it they're still trying to figure out what happened. Maybe it'll give us a breather.
attributes.name: Returning Miner

attributes.content: We can't let our guard down. Plant some sentries amongst the local workers during the day to keep an eye on the Army.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: What about the injured worker?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: She's fine... the one who came with her is taking care of her.
(Whisper) You take care of the sentries. I need to talk to this gentleman.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I'm afraid the place is a little cramped. We don't have much space here.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: It's alright. Our people have settled in. We appreciate what you've done very much... but I don't know your name yet.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: ...Ivan Tulin. We came from the Northern Tundra mines, seeking refuge.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: It's clearly not the first time you've done something like this. I would have thought you were trained soldiers, if you weren't wearing miner clothes.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: You're a fine leader.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: They're fine people. Death has stalked us from the Northern Tundra all the way to Zelgrad. We had to learn how to survive, fast.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Now, if I might know your name as well...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I'm Red. We call ourselves... Reunion.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Reunion? Do you mean—
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: People have been talking about your exploits in Londinium. I'd heard you'd returned to southern Ursus.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I often told them about it while taking them southward...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Most of my group are Infected miners. I see hope in their eyes when I tell them stories about you.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I didn't expect to run into you here.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Did you come to Zelgrad because you heard they've started taking in Infected?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: We had hope. But I needed to find out why Zelgrad was doing it.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: No point in hiding it. We sensed something was off the moment we set foot in the city.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: The military-assigned housing was suspicious, then we heard a civilian clinic was working with the Army. We suspected that they were conducting experiments on the Infected.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: We wanted to find out the truth. Many of us have already given their lives to do so...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: ...I'm sorry for your loss.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Based on our understanding of Ursus, changes to Infected policy do not happen simply out of the kindness of some aristocrat's heart.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: We need to learn more about what's behind it.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Perhaps we all have questions for the two ladies over there.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: In a corner, Closure carefully puts an old jacket over Tonya, who is still unconscious, her lips drying up.
I should get some water... hang in there, Tonya.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure feels someone touch her shoulder and turns around.
Tulin's hand is holding a brown water bottle with gentle eyes, Red standing beside.
Oh, Tulin—sorry, I heard the others call you that...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It's alright. I'm glad to help.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: You and Red have already helped a lot. Thank you so much.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Since the situation's kind of desperate right now, I'm afraid I'll only be able to repay you once we're out of the woods...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: That's not what I mean. But I would like to know why you were there, if possible.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Well...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm afraid I can't talk about it.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It's not that I have any suspicions about you, but the operation I'm participating in is top-secret.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Is it because of me?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: No point denying it. I saw the surprise and wariness on your face when you saw me. You recognized me, or should I say, you recognized Reunion.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: How did you know I was with Reunion?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Besides the symbol on your back, it was the Arts you used to get through, and your blade.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I've... read the files.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Files? Who are you?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: There's no need to ask any more, Red.
Our friend here is from Rhodes Island. She goes by the name Closure.
Y-You're...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The Sarkaz straightens her back at the familiar face, breathing rapidly as she instinctively shields herself with her arm.
Talulah... I should have expected that you might be here when I saw Reunion members.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...I apologize, Closure.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I know Rhodes Island and I did not part on the best of terms.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: What are you doing here? Were the Infected...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I heard about what happened in the Far North, and about Zelgrad...
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I don't believe what Ursus is saying about these things, so I needed to know what they're doing to the Infected.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I expect that words alone will not change your mind, but Reunion is helping the workers here.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: ...I can't say I believe that's the only thing you're after...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But we agree that the walls of Zelgrad hide some kind of secret, not just about the Infected, but also something that I'm not at liberty to disclose.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: If this is what Reunion is here for, I would say there is room for negotiation... I'll think about how to tell you, once this girl here gets better.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Thank you, Closure.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Thank you. For tonight, at least.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I guess I should give you some time to catch up. I'll go check on the sentry arrangements to make sure there's no mistake.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: One moment, please.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Ivan Tulin... that's how you introduced yourself to Red.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: May I talk to you in private?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I didn't expect to run into you here.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: You know the name?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: The words you wrote in the Northern Tundra mines have spread far and wide. I've had the fortune to read it... I was very touched.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I wanted to find your group... but circumstances did not permit it.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: And then you went quiet, and people thought you were... I'm glad to see you here.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: You're younger than I thought, though.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: ...I'm honored.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I want to ask... do you know a woman called Yelena?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Yelena told me she met a remarkable man when she was a guerilla in the Northern Tundra.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: He told her stories about good people being oppressed... he wanted to teach them the meaning of resistance.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Then he bid farewell to the guerillas, because he had to cross the snowfields and journey across Ursus, in order to learn the ending of those stories.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I may need some help. What was Yelena like?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: A white-haired Cautus... one of the most resolute warriors I've ever met.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I knew I would never forget her, the first time I saw her.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I know there are many honorable warriors in the Northern Tundra, but not all of them tell me their names... I'm sorry.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: If your friend and I ever crossed paths, I hope it was good memories that I left behind.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Yes... the memories must have been precious.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Talulah... you are called, yes?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I haven't heard much of the story associated with the name itself, but I have heard plenty about Reunion.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I suppose... it's not an entirely satisfying story.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I can't and I won't judge your group's resolve on rumors and hearsay. Now that we've met, however, I'm sure I'll have plenty of opportunities to know you.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Regardless, you have raised a banner that many can see. It's a great accomplishment.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Besides... I like the name 'Reunion'. We do need to unite our strength.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I believe we can walk together.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: It's a pleasure to meet you, Talulah.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: The youth removes gloves and extends a hand to Talulah, a rough hand covered in chilblains.
Talulah takes the hand.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Where is Father?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: He went out early in the morning, ma'am.
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: What about the butler?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: He went out with Master Vasily.
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: It's been a long time since you were back, ma'am. At least take off your coat and cloak so I can wash them for you—
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: No need. I'm not staying, just coming back to grab something.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Neither Hellagur nor Vetochki have access to the treatment center's administrative files. Looks like I'll have to wait for Dur-nar to come back.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Father's seal should give access to the treatment center's roster and guest list. The study...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The lock was changed?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Marsha!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: No, the servants don't have the key either... who is Father trying to keep out? Why didn't he tell me?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: He never stopped me from entering the study, nor does he have a reason to suddenly—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: —There's a guest, ma'am. Should I have her come in?
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: From House Volkina, it seems.
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: The Duchess Volkina? The 'shadow vice-chairman'? I thought she never communicated with other nobles in private—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Oh, well...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Take her to the reception room.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'll greet the guest on Father's behalf.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Would you like something to drink? I'm afraid options are more limited than you might find at other places. Father went out and you missed our afternoon tea time, so the stove was turned off.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The cup of tea on the table is untouched, if you would like.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: No, thank you. I'm not visiting any other place, nor am I here for tea.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: In that case, what word do you bring from Duchess Volkina?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I have a letter for Duke Gorchikov.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: For Father? I will accept it on his behalf.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: To tell the truth, I did not expect to see you here, Lieutenant Gorchekova.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: My impression was that you do not come home often.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: You know me so well? I'm starting to like you.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Let me tell you the truth as well. I'm opening this letter if I get my hand on it. You can choose to give it to me now, or give it to my father directly when he comes back.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I don't know why they have private dealings with each other, but such an honor is not necessarily a good thing for House Gorchikov.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Now that I know, I must prepare.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hm.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Her Highness said I was to give the letter to you if I saw you here, that it made no difference whether it was delivered to you or your father.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: I was wondering. In rumors and gossip, you have always been Eloysius of the Imperial Guard, not Eloysius of House Gorchikov.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: ...I am both. I have never tried to distance myself from either.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It seems Her Highness was correct.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: Rumors are but rumors. Family is family.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: Of course, I—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Here you go. The Duchess Volkina awaits a response, from you or your father.
attributes.name: Solemn Official

attributes.content: Eloysius clutches the letter. The wax seal on the envelope is hard and irregular, a distorted imprint that is simultaneously forceful yet careless.
Duchess Volkina has always paid little heed to these details that often become a topic of conversation in Grypherburg, living a unique lifestyle that is almost ascetic.
Perhaps this is why she oversees the Ursus Guard, ever the great city's steadfast defenders, aloof and unconcerned with relationships or conflicts.
As though she is living in a vacuum.
But who truly lives in a vacuum?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: She slices the tattered wax seal and takes the letter from the envelope.
Marsha.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...Marsha!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Yes, ma'am?
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: Why was the lock to the study changed?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Master Vasily ordered it two weeks ago, to prevent break-ins, given the situation in the city.
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: Two weeks... was there a break-in?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: No, but one cannot be too careful.
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: Were the window locks changed?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: No, they weren't.
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: Good.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Ma'am?
attributes.name: Maid

attributes.content: Eloysius stuffs the letter into her pocket.
Wait for me outside the study. I need you to run an errand for me, for which I'll give you a token.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Go to Lunin Manor and send Lieutenant Platon Lunin an invitation in my father's name. He is a colleague of mine in the Imperial Guard, and I have something to discuss with him.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Take a car bearing House Gorchikov's coat of arms. Come back directly if he's not home. Do you understand?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It's important, and urgent.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Ma'am, the guest is here.
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: Bring him in.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You were looking for me, General—
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: He stops mid-sentence and turns to leave.
There are plenty of things that even my father can't do.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: He can't give you what you want, Platon.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What do you think you know?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You're the sole heir to one of the most powerful houses in Deity Grypherburg. What do you know of rejection?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You've always gotten everything you wanted. All I'm asking for is an opportunity... yet you will not suffer even that.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Why shouldn't I seek my own path? Just because the Lunin name is a rung below yours?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Tell me...
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: ...It's not what you think.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Take a look at this.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Eloysius hands over Duchess Volkina's letter.

attributes.text: I'm afraid I must respectfully decline your request.
\n\nReassigning officers at a sensitive time like this is likely to lead to speculation, and compromise the longstanding trust and partnership between the Imperial Guard and the Capital Ursus Guard.
\n\nOn an individual level, a soldier should not be selective about their position, or the risks that come with it. Kindly communicate my opinion to Lieutenant Lunin.
The defense of the capital demands unity between the two forces, not separate agendas. I hope you will not allow a moment of weakness to fracture the defenses of Deity Grypherburg.

attributes.content: I take it you didn't expect Marshal Volkina—Duchess Volkina to reject the request, even when it went through my father.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: She is the commander of the Ursus Guard, but also one of the vice chairmen of the State Council. Don't you know that she and my father are not in the same faction?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Transferring from the Imperial Guard to the Ursus Guard used to be completely normal. She clearly refused because she suspected—
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Suspected what? That you were a spy for my father, or for the Imperial Guard?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...I simply asked General Gorchikov for help. Am I not even allowed to do that, after you denied my application?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You know my father's military title is merely ceremonial, don't you?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: And while you may think like a noble, believing that things that have been should always be, I don't think you're actually that stupid.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You think you're qualified to judge me just because you've been my superior officer for a year?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: No, I'm assessing Platon Lunin, top student at the military academy.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I knew him, and I thought he would be like me, blyat...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Top student, as in always second behind someone who never shows up to the training grounds?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: I already explained that I was not at school that year because I was accompanying Chairman Witte on his survey of Central Governorate.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I see. You're using your father's name to summon me so that you can insult me with this piece of paper and the past.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Insult you? No, no, you think too highly of yourself.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What's your point?!
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Let me ask you again, Platon.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Why did you go to the Oripathy treatment center in Odoyev?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Where did you get those military supplies, and how have you taken advantage of the facility's acceptance and transfer of the Infected?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...So that is what you're after.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Fine. I was spying for the Grand Duchess. I went to the treatment center to find a chance to kill all the miners.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: There. Happy?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: No, I'm not happy.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Der'mo—
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: I really feel the military academy should work with intelligence agencies to teach a practical counterintelligence course based on real scenarios, rather than just do written exams.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It's second-rate, responding emotionally to questioning and trying to distract the interrogator with the most obvious undercover identity. I'm not happy with your answer.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'll give you one last chance, Platon. For old times' sake.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Tell the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth, and I will ask Chairman Witte for leniency. I share responsibility for your mistake, after all. At least your family will be unscathed.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: How noble, except for one problem...
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Who's asking you to 'share responsibility'?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You're just speculating. You know those military supplies were clean, and the letter only proves that I asked General Vasily for help, nothing more.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You don't have any other evidence, and you won't find any. Whatever conjectures you have about my dealings with your father, about the treatment center, what's done is done—
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Why are you still so obsessed?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: I need to know the truth! I need to know—I need to know if you were the one who let the assassins in and helped them escape when they made the attempt on the Chairman's life!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I need to know what my father made you do—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hah, I see you don't trust your father... guess what, your father doesn't trust you either.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: He doesn't believe you will achieve anything with your sword. You were already beyond his control, long before the Far North Incident.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: No, you couldn't have known his thoughts.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Couldn't I? He talked a lot, about you. Oh, old Vasily loved you alright, but his contempt of you was such that he would turn to the pro-war faction to protect you—
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: What did you say?!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You didn't know, did you? He prepared a way out for you through that treatment center, because he knew you were weak.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: If you ask me, you should run away before everything goes to hell in the city, just like he arranged.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You see? There's nothing you can do, even if you know I was a spy. I'm not about to prostrate myself before the tsar to beg forgiveness, and you don't have the guts to take my head and claim the reward.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: All we can do is exchange words like some third-rate talk show...
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Ringing began to fill Eloysius's ears as soon as she heard the words 'turn to the pro-war faction'.
She tries to follow Platon's words by reading his lips, but finds it increasingly difficult to focus.
Turn to the pro-war faction... treatment center... a way out?
An intelligence contact point disguised as an Infected treatment center, payment made in supplies instead of cash...
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: All the threads lead to this place, sticking out like a sore thumb.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: What are you hiding here? Who are you harboring?
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: What...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What did Father offer to the pro-war faction?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hah, look at you now! So pathetic you're not even worth hating anymore.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Eloysius grabs Platon's collar—prim and proper, the uniform of a soldier, of the proud Imperial Guard.
The symbol of honor and duty.
Hvatit etogo breda, Platon! Tell me—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Tell me!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Why do you ask if you already guessed? I'm just following orders, as a soldier should.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You knew security measures were relaxed for the treatment center's patient transfers. You took advantage and let the assassins in—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...You've gone mad! All of you have gone mad!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hah... you finally got it right, for once.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: No...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You and I...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hey, Eloysius.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You will come with me to see the Chairman and admit your crimes.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: To hell I will. Unless your father sells me out, why would I betray him when you have no evidence?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Your father is much better at winning people over than you are, Elotta.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Don't make me do this, Platon—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You have another choice, but you won't take it.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: On the hunting grounds, you always killed your prey in one blow, even when it was prepared in advance.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You don't have the stomach to torture me.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You... the Chairman is still alive, but...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Did you know that the Emperor's Blade showed up at the treatment center right after you left?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You left plenty of loose ends, but the Royal Guard doesn't care. All they want is results. If—If there didn't happen to be someone there who can stop them...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: There would have been no one left alive that day.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: And what of it?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You would be dead, along with those Infected who should have been! The perfect outcome!
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Platon...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.text: 'Whether to stand with the empire, or continue to associate yourself with her traitors and enemies...'
'I want to see the answer the next time we meet.'

attributes.content: ...You're right.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I see you've stopped thinking.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: No. I've found the answer. I must make a choice.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What the—
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: You were slow. You had a chance to fight back.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Argh—
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Platon...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I won't let you compound your mistakes.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I can't allow you to drag more people into this.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.text: 'And I will draw my sword for everyone in this building under the protection of Rhodes Island.'
'A thousand times and more, if I have to.'
'Until those like you are repelled, or until I can no longer stand.'

attributes.content: ...Perhaps I'm doing this wrong.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: But if the price to pay is that there will be no place for Father or me in Ursus, then so be it.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: This is what I must do.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Proshchay, Platon.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'll try to protect your family.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The only Imperial Guard left standing in the reception room picks up the bloody letter from the floor.
She tries to wipe the blood, but only succeeds in making it worse.
She gives up.
Eloysius walks over the twitching corpse on the ground, past a terrified maid—
She is going to seek amnesty.
